purpose: Lower the hips under control by bending knees and hips to a adequate depth, then stand back up to full extension, keeping the trunk stable, feet flat and knees tracking over the toes, using body weight only.

how to do a bodyweight squat tutorial

phases.description: Standing start; hips move back and down while knees and hips flex until the bottom position.
Brief lowest position with maximum knee and hip flexion.
Drive up through the feet, extending knees and hips back to standing.

faults.description: Does not squat deep enough; hips stay well above knee level and knees stay relatively extended at the bottom.
faults.cue_intent: Encourage sitting the hips lower toward at least thigh-parallel.
faults.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether the person is limited by balance, tightness or just chose a partial range.
faults.fix_intent: Suggest slowing the descent, widening stance slightly or holding support to practise going deeper.

faults.description: Knee collapses inward relative to the hip-ankle line during the squat.
faults.cue_intent: Cue pushing the knees out in line with the toes.
faults.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether the knees feel like they drift inward when standing up.
faults.fix_intent: Suggest a slightly wider stance with toes turned out and actively spreading the floor with the feet.

faults.description: Trunk leans excessively forward from vertical at the bottom, turning the squat into a hip hinge.
faults.cue_intent: Cue keeping the chest up and torso more upright.
faults.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether the person feels pitched forward or on their toes.
faults.fix_intent: Suggest raising the chest, reaching arms forward as a counterbalance, and working on ankle mobility.

faults.description: Shins lean far forward with the ankle closing excessively, a sign weight shifts to the toes and heels may lift.
faults.cue_intent: Cue keeping weight over the whole foot, heels down.
faults.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether the heels feel like they lift or the weight drifts to the toes.
faults.fix_intent: Suggest sitting hips back more and, if needed, a small heel elevation while ankle mobility improves.

faults.description: Feet placed very close together relative to hip width, limiting depth and stability.
faults.cue_intent: Cue setting feet about shoulder width.
faults.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether this narrow stance is intentional.
faults.fix_intent: Suggest stepping feet to shoulder width with toes slightly out.

faults.description: Does not return to a fully extended standing position at the end of the ascent.
faults.cue_intent: Cue standing fully tall and squeezing the glutes at the top.
faults.ask_if_unsure_intent: Ask whether the person is stopping early to keep tension or to go faster.
faults.fix_intent: Suggest finishing each rep upright with hips and knees extended before starting the next.

outcomes.description: Complete range of motion: reaching adequate depth and returning to full standing.
Knees track in line with the toes through the whole rep.
Stays balanced over mid-foot with a reasonably upright trunk throughout.

links.mechanism: More knee flexion at the bottom indicates greater squat depth.
More hip flexion at the bottom shows the hips have descended further.
Less inward knee deviation keeps the knee aligned over the foot.
Some forward lean is needed to keep balance over the feet, but too much shifts load and loses the upright squat pattern.
A stance near shoulder width gives room for the hips to descend between the knees.
Some forward knee travel lets the trunk stay upright, while too little forces more lean.

session_ideas: Set up a side-on camera and do 10 slow squats focusing on depth.
Do a set of 8 squats with a front-facing camera to check knee tracking.
Compare a normal-stance set with a slightly wider stance set.

vocabulary_proposals.name: height.hip_relative_to_knee
vocabulary_proposals.why: Direct measure of whether hips reach thigh-parallel depth, which hip height over ankle only approximates.

vocabulary_proposals.name: heel_lift
vocabulary_proposals.why: Heel rising from the ground cannot be tested directly with current features.
